caption: three pre-run fueling mistakes I see every week as a period recovery dietitian for runners. 1 running fasted. 'I'll just eat after.' running on empty starts your day in an energy deficit, and even easy miles need energy. do it daily and it's a fast track to low energy availability. carbs before, like a banana, toast or dried fruit, beat nothing every time. 2 using coffee/caffeine as fuel. caffeine is a stimulant, not energy... 3 choosing the wrong thing (protein). a protein shake or bar right before a run isn't pre-run fuel, carbs are... before a run your body wants carbs, not willpower, caffeine or a protein shake. for more fueling breakdowns, listen to my podcast, new episodes every Thursday!
